prompt:
A sprite sheet of 9 separate objects for a top-down JRPG map, to be placed on top of the painted map shown in the reference image. Match the reference exactly: the same hi-bit pixel-painting style and brushwork, the same palette and material textures, the same soft light from the upper left (lit tops and left sides, shaded right sides), the same classic steep 3/4 top-down view (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 3 x 3 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom) with wide empty space between them; every object fully separate, nothing touching, nothing cut off. Draw each object large, filling most of its grid cell. The objects, in order: 1) tall black iron harbour street lamp post with a glass lantern head (unlit, dark glass); 2) small iron and glass lantern standing on the ground (unlit); 3) wooden notice board on two posts with pinned paper notices and a small roof; 4) fish-and-fruit market stall with a red-and-white striped cloth awning on poles; 5) small wooden signpost with a blank plank sign; 6) terracotta pot with red flowers; 7) weathered oak barrel with iron hoops; 8) wooden cargo crate; 9) short black iron mooring bollard.
Background: fully transparent. No ground, no floor, no shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers. Even albedo lighting: no night, no glow halos and no light spilling around the objects (lamps unlit).

Classic steep 3/4 overhead view, looking down at top surfaces and front faces of upright objects; light from upper left with illuminated top and left planes, darker right planes, even daylight albedo. Each sprite centered and large within its own cell with all parts fully in frame and all nine sprites fully disconnected. EXACT 3x3 reading order: row 1: (1) slender tall black wrought-iron harbor street lamp post, sturdy base and glass-paneled lantern head with UNLIT dark glass; (2) small black iron and dark-glass lantern standing on its base, UNLIT; (3) rustic wooden notice board supported by two posts, small overhanging wooden roof, multiple pinned blank beige paper notices without any writing. row 2: (4) wooden fish-and-fruit market stall, red and cream striped cloth canopy on poles, fish and assorted fruit neatly displayed on counter; (5) small wooden signpost bearing one wide BLANK unlettered plank sign; (6) terracotta flowerpot filled with dark green stems and vibrant little red flowers. row 3: (7) upright weathered oak barrel with black iron hoops, visible round top; (8) square wooden cargo crate with slatted top and cross-braced front, visible top and right side; (9) short dark black-iron harbor mooring bollard with squat central upright, rounded transverse cap and flanged foot.
